promise: End the Russia-Ukraine war within 24 hours of becoming president
description: Trump made a 24-hour peace claim during his campaign. On January 7, 2025 he discussed a six-month timeframe instead. Fighting continued after inauguration.
evidence: January 7 reporting describes a six-month hope.
AP reported after inauguration that the war continued.

review.note: January 7 remarks discussed six months, not a renewed 24-hour pledge. Earlier campaign pledge/failure supported, but replacement original date needs sourcing.

promise: Immediately bring prices down and begin changing energy policy on the first day in office
description: At the August 15, 2024 event, Trump said he would immediately bring prices down, then said energy-policy changes would start on day one. Later CPI measures varied by category; monthly January data cannot isolate the inauguration day's effect.
evidence: No Day One price drop; food and egg prices rose in January 2025
Democratic lawmakers' January 2025 letter cited unfulfilled price promises

review.note: Transcript places 'Starting on day one' with the ensuing energy-policy sentence; avoid splicing separate sentences as a single exact quote. Monthly CPI is not a daily price measurement, and January includes pre-inauguration days. Later price measures are mixed by category. A January 31 deadline is editorial, not the spoken pledge.

promise: "If the hostages are not released prior to January 20, 2025, there will be all hell to pay."
description: On December 2, 2024, Trump threatened consequences if hostages were not released before his January 20 inauguration. The statement did not specify a measurable action by which its threatened consequences could be scored.
evidence: Not all hostages were released by January 20, 2025
Ceasefire deal led to phased releases starting January 19, 2025; Trump credited his envoy with the deal

review.note: This is a conditional threat of consequences, not a guarantee that Hamas would release all hostages. Neither causal credit for the agreement nor a measurable fulfillment test follows from the statement. January 19 was implementation, not necessarily deal announcement; exact deal chronology needs a separate source.
